## Checklist

### Originality

- [ ] All prose, examples, diagrams and challenges are my own work for this repository.
- [ ] Nothing is copied or closely paraphrased from a book, course, blog or video.
- [ ] No commercial book, course or author is named as a source.

### Scope and safety

- [ ] No exploit, shellcode, payload or malware-development content.
- [ ] No content on defeating copy protection, licensing or DRM.
- [ ] No third-party or downloaded binaries; challenge binaries rebuild from `solutions/NN/src/`.
- [ ] No flags or answers outside `solutions/`.

### Quality

- [ ] `make all-checks` passes locally.
- [ ] No emoji or decorative symbols (`python3 tools/no_emoji.py`).
- [ ] Translations updated for all four languages, or this PR states which are pending.
